title: Artiva Biotherapeutics Plunges Into Crisis Over Patient Deaths and Possible Liquidation
summary: Artiva Biotherapeutics Inc. The clinical-stage biotechnology company decided on its cell therapy candidate, AlloNK (AB-101), following an extensive risk-benefit assessment. title: Why Is Artiva Biotherapeutics Discontinuing AlloNK Development and Cutting 94% of Its Workforce?
summary: Artiva Biotherapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:ARTV) announced on October 27, 2026, that it will discontinue development of its AlloNK (AB-101) cell therapy following a review of updated clinical results, longer-term patient outcomes and two fatal safety events involving participants in its clinical studies.

title: Artiva to quit autoimmune cell therapy work, cut staff after patient deaths
summary: The disclosure makes Artiva the third company to recently report fatal events in an autoimmune cell therapy trial, following announcements from Novartis and Bristol Myers Squibb.

title: Artiva Scraps Development Of Lead Drug Candidate After Patient Deaths — ARTV Stock Heads For Worst Session In Over 18 Months
